name: kicad-collab-web
description: React + TypeScript chrome for the Junction web editor (bundled into static/dist/ui.js)

scripts.build: npm run gen:version && npm run gen:cad && node scripts/gen-icon-pack.js && node scripts/build-python.mjs && npm run build:canvas && npm run build:kicad-dialogs && npm run build:props && npm run build:sch-tools && npm run build:pcb-tools && npm run build:editor && npm run build:boot && npm run build:parts && npm run build:router && npm run build:landing && npm run build:github && npm run build:styleguide && npm run build:admin && npm run build:viewer3d && npm run build:sim-ngspice && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:harness && npm run build:fab && npm run build:cad && esbuild web/main.tsx --bundle --minify --sourcemap --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --define:MENU_SPEC_SHARED=true --outfile=static/dist/ui.js --legal-comments=none && tailwindcss -i web/shared/styles/tailwind.css -o static/dist/ui.css --minify
scripts.dev: node scripts/gen-version.js && esbuild web/domains/pcb/canvas/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --sourcemap --outfile=static/kicad-canvas.js --watch & esbuild web/main.tsx --bundle --sourcemap --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"development\" --outfile=static/dist/ui.js --watch & tailwindcss -i web/shared/styles/tailwind.css -o static/dist/ui.css --watch & wait
scripts.check: npm run gen:version && npm run gen:cad && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: cd static && for t in render perf shapes sch-tools pcb-tools router diffpair tuning redundant pcb-sizes props dialogs autoroute fieldsolve ctxmenus library schdialogs pcb-dialogs pad-model viewer3d menus pcb-qa themes fab odb vrml plot zonefill pcb-sweep ruler sch-nets change-symbols global-edit sch-items pcb-edit3 pcb-review3 sym-props line-ending label-autorotate sch-pins pcb-rules pcb-silk pcb-thermal pcb-drc-sweep4 symedit symedit-pins symedit-checker symedit-tools symedit-libdoc symedit-find symedit-merge symedit-symdir fpedit-doc fpedit-tools fpedit-dialogs table-model table-text table-collab sim-model drc-copper fp-wizard zstd sim-ibis sch-visuals sch-line-ends sch-edit-points sch-format sch-text-outline sch-sweep7-fixes pcb-visuals pcb-feedback ui-chrome sweep7-ui pcb-find pcb-field-edit sweep6-table-xref sweep6-variants sweep6-spice sweep6-netlists sim-parity sweep6-update-variants sweep6-variant-fixes pcb-menus6 exchange-footprints global-delete global-text-graphics snap-anchors lib-table sch-sweep8 sweep8-dlg sch-sweep9 sweep9-chrome sweep9-pcb fp-browse feat-common panes lib-tables model3d libtree cvpcb schdlg pcbdlg selmods embedded-file editor-load multi-top-level itemdoc doctabs project-shell mechanical-doc mechanical-kernel assembly-doc mechanical-features mechanical-exchange cad-analysis cad-boardlink pcb-mech cad-mcp cad-history sketch-solver sketch-regions sketch-ops sketch-kernel assembly-solver assembly-model mechanical-patterns mechanical-collab mechanical-board fieldsolve multi-top-level cad-units cad-fields; do node tests/$t.test.js || exit 1; done && cd .. && npm run test:review && npm run test:compact && npm run test:drcrules
